description: Personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences is processed without official authority or legal authorization. Article 10 restricts such processing to control by official authority or when authorized by law.
applicability: Applicable to processing of criminal conviction and offence data. Includes background checks, employment screening, and any system storing criminal history information.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through data inventory review to identify criminal conviction data. Verify legal authorization or official authority basis for any such processing.
